detailed_description: The Env File Parser reads pasted dotenv-style KEY=value lines and displays parsed entries with line numbers, duplicate-key warnings, empty-value indicators, and masked sensitive values. After parsing, you can copy the entries back as dotenv text or convert them to simple JSON or YAML output. Comment and blank lines are ignored, and unsupported lines are reported as issues.
usage_steps: Paste dotenv-style KEY=value content into the input text area.
Click Parse to inspect the entries.
Review issues such as invalid lines or duplicate keys.
Use Show Values if you need to reveal masked sensitive values.
Choose ENV, JSON, or YAML as the output format.
Copy the generated output when ready.
usage_examples: Inspect a small .env snippet for duplicate variable names.
Convert parsed dotenv entries into JSON for a local note or fixture.
Copy a YAML version of simple environment variables for documentation.
Check which keys look sensitive before sharing a sanitized example.
